relationships.subject: carbamazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: carbamazepine and oxcarbazepine efficiently suppress abnormal high‑frequency neuronal firing by blocking voltage‑gated sodium channels

relationships.subject: trigeminal neuralgia
relationships.evidence_quote: In TN models, TG neurons exhibit heightened excitability and upregulated expression of neuropeptides such as calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP).

key_findings: Review of trigeminal neuralgia animal models, multi-region pain circuits, and molecular targets (Nav1.7/Cav3.2, CGRP antibodies, NRF2, botulinum toxin).
Species difference: human DRG neurons co-express CGRP and P2X3 whereas these populations are largely segregated in rodents.
